Escape ended the pending command/Close and owned PID 15836 exited.
high_failure_diagnosis.mechanism: brep_snapshot.hxx:201-205 refuses when snapshot points reach max_points (or u32); brep.rs:483 forwards remaining max_points. editing.rs:1269-1295 subtracts held intermediate usage before each sequential Union snapshot and keeps the old intermediate until the next is admitted.
high_failure_diagnosis.inference: The effective snapshot point ceiling is at most the configured 2000000 and is reduced by held intermediates, well below u32. This is a structural/display snapshot point refusal, not proof of invalid exact Boolean mathematics or physical RAM exhaustion. Exact fold iteration and effective remaining point count were not logged.

definitions.ram: Windows process resident working set and committed private bytes, MiB=1048576 bytes; not VRAM. Light peaks end at settled performance endpoint before native verification/history inventory; High ends at refusal. Endpoints differ because High never committed.
definitions.undo: Live retained counts under unchanged loaded policy; not a count of future capacity or proof of replaying every step. Full managed inventory is a conservative storage estimate, not OS RAM.
definitions.fps: Distinct encoded Perspective frames under pointer navigation; not UI callbacks or RDP client video FPS. Light result lacks uninterrupted steady samples because a 32-second post-commit gap exhausted the eight-second window; High has no Boolean result.
